message.reasoning_content:
The user wants to close out a rejected invoice.

F1 is a reject-severity stock finding. The policy requires disposition return_to_vendor for quantities over what we can accept. The vendor must fix the excess and resubmit.

The vendor email must not reveal internal stock levels. It should only list the specific corrections needed. The WidgetB quantity of 11 exceeds the accepted amount.

The corrected invoice must reduce WidgetB to a quantity we can accept. The exact numbers are 6 and 5 units at $500 each, totaling $5,500.

The vendor email must not specify a maximum quantity. Telling them to reduce WidgetB to 10 would reveal internal stock levels.

The vendor email should ask for a corrected invoice with a reduced WidgetB quantity and matching line amounts. The audit log may cite stock levels since it is internal.
